sentences.text: For this UCB, penal interest is not permitted; any penalty for default must be levied only as penal charges and not as penal interest.
The in-force directions do not give a numeric amount or percentage that can be added to the loan rate, and they require penal charges to be reasonable and not capitalised.
The older penal-charges circulars were superseded or withdrawn, so they do not provide a current allowance for adding penal interest to the loan rate.

missing.searched: Looked for an in-force rule allowing a UCB to add a specified penal interest amount or percentage to the loan rate; the current directions only say penal interest is not permitted and do not state any numeric add-on.
